import Sigma.LimitSeparation
import Sigma.SuccessorBounds

/-! The actual stage algebras, generated by both split pieces and every finite set. -/
noncomputable section
open Set Cardinal ThesisCommon
namespace SigmaNonprimarity

def stageAlgebra {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I) : BooleanSubalgebra (Set ℕ) :=
  BooleanSubalgebra.closure ({A : Set ℕ | A.Finite} ∪
    Set.range (fun p : V × Bool => G p.1.val p.2))

theorem stageAlgebra_finite_mem {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I)
    {A : Set ℕ} (hA : A.Finite) : A ∈ stageAlgebra G V :=
  BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inl hA)

theorem stageAlgebra_generator_mem {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) {V : Set I}
    {i : I} (hi : i ∈ V) (b : Bool) : G i b ∈ stageAlgebra G V :=
  BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨(⟨i,hi⟩,b), rfl⟩)

theorem stageAlgebra_le {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I)
    (B : BooleanSubalgebra (Set ℕ))
    (hfin : ∀ A : Set ℕ, A.Finite → A ∈ B)
    (hgen : ∀ i ∈ V, ∀ b, G i b ∈ B) : stageAlgebra G V ≤ B := by
  apply BooleanSubalgebra.closure_le.mpr
  rintro A (hA | ⟨⟨i,b⟩,rfl⟩)
  · exact hfin A hA
  · exact hgen i.val i.property b

theorem stageAlgebra_mono {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ)
    {V W : Set I} (hVW : V ⊆ W) : stageAlgebra G V ≤ stageAlgebra G W :=
  stageAlgebra_le G V _ (fun _ h => stageAlgebra_finite_mem G W h)
    (fun _ h b => stageAlgebra_generator_mem G (hVW h) b)

theorem stageAlgebra_congr {I : Type} (G H : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ V, G i = H i) : stageAlgebra G V = stageAlgebra H V := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply stageAlgebra_le G V _ (fun _ h => stageAlgebra_finite_mem H V h)
    intro i hi b
    rw [h i hi]
    exact stageAlgebra_generator_mem H hi b
  · apply stageAlgebra_le H V _ (fun _ h => stageAlgebra_finite_mem G V h)
    intro i hi b
    rw [← h i hi]
    exact stageAlgebra_generator_mem G hi b

theorem stageAlgebra_cardinal_le {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I)
    (κ : Cardinal) (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (hV : #V ≤ κ) : #(stageAlgebra G V) ≤ κ := by
  apply booleanClosure_cardinal_le _ κ hκ
  have hfin : #{A : Set ℕ | A.Finite} ≤ κ := by
    haveI : Countable {A : Set ℕ | A.Finite} := Set.Countable.setOf_finite.to_subtype
    exact Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0.trans hκ
  have hgen : #(Set.range (fun p : V × Bool => G p.1.val p.2)) ≤ κ := by
    apply Cardinal.mk_range_le.trans
    rw [Cardinal.mk_prod]
    simpa only [Cardinal.lift_id] using
      (mul_le_mul' hV (Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0.trans hκ : #Bool ≤ κ)).trans_eq
        (Cardinal.mul_eq_self hκ)
  exact (Cardinal.mk_union_le _ _).trans ((add_le_add hfin hgen).trans_eq (Cardinal.add_eq_self hκ))

theorem stageAlgebra_insert {I : Type} (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : Set I) (i : I) :
    stageAlgebra G (insert i V) = adjoinSet (adjoinSet (stageAlgebra G V) (G i false)) (G i true) := by
  have hbase : stageAlgebra G V ≤ adjoinSet (adjoinSet (stageAlgebra G V) (G i false)) (G i true) :=
    fun _ h => BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inl (BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inl h)))
  have hf : G i false ∈ adjoinSet (adjoinSet (stageAlgebra G V) (G i false)) (G i true) :=
    BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inl (BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)))
  have ht : G i true ∈ adjoinSet (adjoinSet (stageAlgebra G V) (G i false)) (G i true) :=
    BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply stageAlgebra_le G (insert i V) _
      (fun _ h => hbase (stageAlgebra_finite_mem G V h))
    intro j hj b
    rcases hj with rfl | hj
    · cases b <;> assumption
    · exact hbase (stageAlgebra_generator_mem G hj b)
  · apply adjoin_le_of_mem
    · exact adjoin_le_of_mem (stageAlgebra_mono G (Set.subset_insert i V))
        (stageAlgebra_generator_mem G (Set.mem_insert i V) false)
    · exact stageAlgebra_generator_mem G (Set.mem_insert i V) true

theorem stageAlgebra_iUnion {I K : Type} [Nonempty K] (G : I → Bool → Set ℕ) (V : K → Set I) :
    stageAlgebra G (⋃ k, V k) =
      BooleanSubalgebra.closure (⋃ k, (stageAlgebra G (V k) : Set (Set ℕ))) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply stageAlgebra_le
    · intro A hA
      exact BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨Classical.arbitrary K, stageAlgebra_finite_mem G _ hA⟩)
    · intro i hi b
      obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
      exact BooleanSubalgebra.subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨k, stageAlgebra_generator_mem G hk b⟩)
  · apply BooleanSubalgebra.closure_le.mpr
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hA
    exact stageAlgebra_mono G (Set.subset_iUnion V k) hk

end SigmaNonprimarity
